name: Camping Zwerwald
beschreibung: Camping Zwerwald is situated in the Tyrolean Alps at an altitude of around 1,000 metres, serenely surrounded by lush forests and meadows. The campsite provides pitches for motorhomes, tents, and seasonal guests. Amenities include clean sanitary facilities, a cosy small restaurant, and a children's playground. Scenic hiking paths wind through the alpine mountain landscape nearby. The campsite welcomes guests from May to September.
